custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the white base. Real ice cream usually has a slight sheen due to fat content and surface melting. This image shows a very dry, matte texture. Also, evaluate the spoon's contact point: does it press into the ice cream? The lack of displacement suggests a structural artifact. Consider if the 'ice cream' is actually misclassified whipped cream or meringue.
